cas-0739 accepts the single-line phone footer's outage-state ellipsis for a long machine name; since cas-cae9 the outage words lead ("Can't reach Build Server…"), so the ellipsis shortens the name, never the verb. cas-7374/cas-2078 accept the resting conversation row's single-line machine-name ellipsis (cas-766c, cas-1ca1): the row's .conversation-machine title and its spoken name carry the whole machine name, and the focused or open row shows it whole, wrapped in the title column. Only the resting row is truncated.
